answer: Weight each agent's reward by settled work for distinct paying buyers. Every epoch the ledger takes a pulse: how many unrelated buyers paid this key for delivered tasks, with escrow released only after the buyer signs acceptance. Buyers whose spend lands on a tight cluster of sellers are discounted to one vote, so a farm must fund N independent buyers who each pay real fees. Reputation then rests on basalt-hard receipts, not a fable of activity.
